findings.evidence: Each successful DirectGPU frame performs two StretchRect copies, issues a D3D9 EVENT, then synchronously polls GetData in a SwitchToThread loop for up to ProducerFenceBudgetMs before publishing the slot. This is on the game Present path. Host R32 later uses asynchronous D3D11 consumption ACK, so host-side consumption no longer requires an xrEndFrame CPU wait, but producer-side copy completion still introduces a per-frame CPU/GPU synchronization point.
findings.risk: Up to the configured producer fence budget can be paid on every DirectGPU frame, directly consuming the 11.1ms budget at 90Hz and plausibly contributing to HMD stutter. Two full-eye StretchRect copies are also mandatory in this path.
findings.expectedFixDirection: Do not remove slot safety. First instrument producer-fence wait distribution and copy cost. Then evaluate publishing only after an asynchronous producer completion state machine, or a ring-slot lifecycle that separates copy-submitted from host-consumable without blocking the game thread. Preserve generation/ACK reuse guarantees.
findings.verifier: LEVEL0 deterministic state-machine test for slot reuse + telemetry histogram of producer wait us; LEVEL2 PERFORMANCE HMD only if static/build gates pass.

findings.evidence: Every successful Desktop Duplication copy calls MaybeLogCapturePixels; once per 5 seconds it creates a staging texture, CopySubresourceRegion then immediately Map(D3D11_MAP_READ), which may synchronously wait for GPU completion. It is unconditional with respect to an explicit diagnostics/telemetry flag.
findings.risk: Periodic host hitch on theater/SBS fallback paths; can contaminate performance comparisons and produce a visible cadence spike approximately every five seconds.
findings.expectedFixDirection: Gate pixel readback behind an explicit diagnostic capture/telemetry switch, or make it asynchronous with a nonblocking query/staging ring. Default CORRECTNESS/PERFORMANCE runtime should not synchronously read back pixels.
findings.verifier: LEVEL0 source-policy check: default runtime has no Map(D3D11_MAP_READ) in recurring Capture path; optional diagnostic mode remains available.

findings.evidence: vrhost/CMakeLists.txt defines protocol/core/host-state/v2-v3/pose/runtime-eligibility/r23-bundle/r32-policy smoke executables, but DX9Ex Active Validation builds only target outrun-vr-host and does not build or execute these deterministic no-HMD tests.
findings.risk: OpenXR/IPC/generation policy regressions can compile in the production host while existing deterministic regression programs are never exercised by the candidate gate.
findings.expectedFixDirection: Add a lightweight no-HMD smoke step to the host job (or a dependent validation job) that builds and runs the existing smoke targets. Keep it candidate-branch scoped and avoid backend matrices.
findings.verifier: GitHub Actions candidate run showing each existing smoke target built and exited 0.

falsified_or_demoted: TargetRefreshRateHz=0 hardcode regression not found: host RequestedRefreshRateHz returns 0 when unset and refresh request helper returns without requesting when <=0.
Monitor resolution driving eye resolution not found: projection swapchain uses OpenXR recommendedImageRectWidth/Height times renderScale and clamps to runtime max.
Unbounded xrWaitSwapchainImage hang hypothesis falsified for infinite waits: forced include bounds XR_INFINITE_DURATION to 20ms slices / 250ms total.
DirectGPU host-side per-frame Flush hypothesis falsified in R32: Flush is deferred until an ACK slot remains busy.
Direct shared-handle reopen-every-frame hypothesis falsified: R32 host caches opened shared textures per slot/generation/handles/size/format.
Same-frame pending ACK forcing fallback hypothesis falsified: R32 allows same frame/generation reuse while its EVENT remains pending.
Reference-space change ignored hypothesis falsified: LOCAL change is deferred until predictedDisplayTime reaches changeTime, then host/shared/compositor histories are invalidated.
Session STOPPING stale stereo reuse hypothesis falsified: view history, matched stereo state, compositor source validity and processed frame cursor are reset.
Frame metadata torn-read hypothesis substantially falsified: host performs before/after immutable-frame identity comparison around source acquisition before accepting a frame.
Ring producer overwrite-without-host-ACK hypothesis falsified in R32 game path: producer checks GPU-completed ACK before reusing an occupied slot.
